style.promptPrefix: TO BE LOCKED: choose one prefix and seed before generating any frame, then never change them — style consistency across the set depends on it. Suggested register: muted oil-painting realism, grey-green North Sea palette, low fog, no visible faces on the dead.
style.note: Frames are generated offline and hand-curated (ROADMAP Phase 2). Drop finished PNGs into apps/web/public/art/<slot>.png — the UI renders a placeholder gradient for any slot without a file, so partial sets are playable.

slots.brief: The causeway at low tide, village roofline breaking grey water, church tower upright, no birds over the water.
Slick cobbles vanishing under a returning tide, black weed, cart rails.
Drowned street at ebb: weeded doorways, a cart fused to the road with barnacle.
The square: church with ringing tower, broken graveyard gate, one thread of chimney smoke down Harbor Row.
Headstones in standing water, several graves open, surface disturbed.
One tended grave above the waterline; clean stone reading HE STAYED; the grave open and empty.
Chandlery loft interior, small fire, forty years of careful hoarding, an old man's silhouette.
Pews under three feet of clear water, standing congregation facing the altar, backs to the viewer.
Spiral wooden stair rotted soft, rope descending through the middle, light from above.
The bell mid-swing with no hand on it; scratched bronze reading WHILE IT RINGS THEY SLEEP.
Stairs descending past the foundation waterline into unmoving dark.
A wight in a churchwarden's coat between the viewer and a bell rope, two shadows at its sides. Not eager.
The bell hanging still for the first time in forty years; water beginning, very slightly, to move.
Black crypt water closing over bronze; distant lights going out grave by grave.
A lit belfry at dusk seen from the causeway, one figure at the rope, sea calm.
The causeway at a run, the sea inhaling behind; morning: a coastline with no village and a road that bends inland.

combatStates.note: The remaining ~29 frames of the target ~45 are combat-state and variant frames (each encounter at start/bloodied/won, endings by time of day). Enumerate them here as they are generated; the slot naming convention is <base-slot>-<variant>.
